title: Kuheran kar'na Penebus
cat: Sengasara Tuhan Yesus dan Jumat Agung
credits: Syair: Alas! And did my savior bleed; Hugh Wilson

rows: Ku-he-ran kar'-na Pe-ne-bus ter-sa-lib un-tuk-ku Ter-cu-rah da-rah ku-dus-Mu me-ne-bus do-sa-ku

verses: Kuheran kar'na Penebus tersalib untukku Tercurah darah kudusMu menebus dosaku
Betapa agung rahmatMu, Kau tanggung dosaku
